ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.Biography: Backstory uses the native CoC7 format: either a single block or multiple sections based on system settings.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.CreationPoints: Creation point summary. Adjust values on the Skills tab in edit mode.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.Development: Marked skills use the native CoC7 development phase. You can test a single skill or run the phase for all marked skills at once.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.DevelopmentShi: Shift + click performs the native quick development check without posting intermediate rolls to chat.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.DevelopmentSki: Successful development increases the skill using the native CoC7 roll and clears the mark automatically.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.EraPrices: Configure item availability and pricing across historical eras.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.InvestigatorRo: Characteristics, Sanity, Luck, and damage bonus use native CoC7 checks. Shift + click performs a fast roll without a dialog.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.KeeperItemSecr: Secret item details visible only to the Keeper (players cannot see this block).
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.KeeperNotes: This section is visible to the Keeper only. It stores hidden notes, Sanity encounters, immunities, and Mythos progress.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.LocationMode: Toggles an NPC between a standard Keeper character sheet and a location sheet.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.ManualCredit: Toggle between automatic Credit Rating wealth calculation and manual values.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.Possessions: Possessions are stored in native CoC7 Items. Click an item to open its sheet. Finances use the native CoC7 wealth model.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.ResumeCreation: Step-by-step creation for this investigator is still in progress. You can resume from the saved step.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.RollHelp: Click a characteristic, Sanity, Luck, or skill name — CoC7 will handle the roll. Shift + click performs a fast roll without a dialog.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.RollHelpCreatu: Click a characteristic or skill name — CoC7 will handle the roll. Shift + click performs a fast roll without a dialog.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.ShareItemInCha: Send item card with description to chat.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.SkillRollHelp: Click the skill name for a native CoC7 check. The checkbox on the right is used for skill development.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.StartCreation: The Ginzzzu’s CoC7 Player HUD step-by-step wizard is available for blank assigned investigators.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Hints.WeaponRoll: «Attack» creates a native CoC7 combat card and expends ammunition when firing. «Check skill» only rolls the percentile check. «Roll damage» rolls the formula separately and does not expend ammo.
ginzzzu-coc7-sheets.Messages.Development: Development phase is disabled in CoC7 settings.
